feature_flag.name: include_evidence_contract
feature_flag.other_endpoints: No opt-in addition to QA or Research API

input_semantics: The JSON schema describes prospective shape; existing Pydantic coercions and ignored extra fields remain unchanged for baseline fields. Only the new flag is strict boolean.

Opt-in query must be non-whitespace and at most 2000 characters; paper scope at most 38 UUIDs, preserving EvidenceContract limits. Violations return 422 before retrieval. False/absent flag imposes no new query/scope limits.
Caller cannot submit EvidenceItem, source identifiers, contract status, trusted manifest, provider/model/revision or collection overrides to the adapter.
Exactly one SOURCE requirement is constructed by code. No planner, semantic decomposition, min-source inference, dynamic revision or evidence judgment.

internal_input.required_precondition: Existing _run_hybrid succeeded, including P0-R1 registry/physical/actual-provider checks; no IndexIdentityError was caught or downgraded.
internal_input.canonical_input: Only explicit versioned chunk file, its index manifest, and parsed block file for returned, validated paper UUIDs beneath resolved parsed_root. No global glob, legacy fallback, external fetch or scientific backend loader by adapter.
internal_input.empty_context: Legal input after successful retrieval. No canonical file read is needed; typed MISSING_EVIDENCE gap and MISSING availability.
internal_input.mutability: Treat context and trace as immutable inputs; never repair, reorder, overwrite or annotate them in place.

output_contract.default: Exact existing HybridRetrievalResponse {context, trace}; evidence_contract key absent, not null. No adapter calls or extra provenance reads.
output_contract.opt_in: Existing context and trace plus required evidence_contract sidecar defined by output_schema.
output_contract.planned_fastapi_response_model: HybridRetrievalEvidenceResponse | HybridRetrievalResponse; extension has required evidence_contract. Verify actual serialization in P1-D1; no global exclude_unset.
output_contract.qualification_meaning: Only structural identity/provenance and source availability. No semantic truth, support confidence, correctness, full question coverage or corpus recall qualification.

trace.description: Exact existing RetrievalTrace serialization, pinned by baseline source and entry_audit. Do not drop defaults or change timing/IDs in place.

description.const: Observe resolvable document/block/page provenance for this retrieval response.

cross_field_invariants: Contract ID is stable_contract_id(exact query). Question is exact query, never truncated. Contract_id is not globally unique across document scopes: correlate by trace_id plus source_scope plus retrieval_identity.
R1 source_scope preserves explicit paper filter order/values; empty scope means the existing retrieval scope, not a claim of all-corpus coverage.
Evidence ID = canonical paper UUID + ':' + unchanged chunk_id, a derived adapter reference, never a claimed preexisting source ID.

Required provenance is paper_id, nonempty chunk_id, unique nonempty block_ids, complete exact block_page_map, section_path and valid page span, all matching canonical chunk and parsed blocks. Nonempty text must be the unchanged returned prefix of canonical chunk_text. Score must be finite.

Primary EvidenceItem.block_id = first original block ID; page = authoritative map entry for that block. Full block/page identities and original page_start remain in provenance. Never assume every block is on page_start.
All evidence/coverage references resolve to validated sidecar evidence. Gaps have empty evidence_ids; rejected candidates are referenced only in errors, never as evidence support.

All valid items and sources preserve retrieval order. Duplicate identical (paper_id,chunk_id) may share one sidecar reference without deleting original context; conflicting duplicate identities are rejected.

Status OK + AVAILABLE for valid sources and no errors; OK + MISSING for empty successful retrieval; PARTIAL + PARTIAL for some valid sources with rejected candidates; ERROR + UNAVAILABLE when candidates exist but none can be verified, or adapter fails.

MISSING/UNAVAILABLE emits one EvidenceGap(MISSING_EVIDENCE). PARTIAL emits one missing structural evidence gap for rejected candidates. AVAILABLE emits no gaps. None means semantic question is answered.

EvidenceRequirement.status remains UNSEARCHED only because semantic support is unevaluated; retrieval_completed=true makes actual completed retrieval explicit. No RequirementCoverage/SUPPORTED/verdict/confidence output.

Additional representation errors return 200 with explicit sidecar status/errors after successful retrieval; they never alter or conceal original upstream retrieval errors. HTTP status is not a semantic success signal.

failure_semantics.upstream_identity_conflict: Original HTTP 409, no query embedding/search where P0-R1 rejects, no adapter, no result, no fallback.
failure_semantics.upstream_missing_invalid_physical_manife: Original HTTP 503, no adapter, no downgrade to typed gap.
failure_semantics.upstream_other_failure: Original status/error envelope unchanged; no sidecar synthetic success.
failure_semantics.opt_in_validation: 422 before retrieval for new flag/query/scope violations only.
failure_semantics.per_item_structural_failure: Reject candidate from sidecar, return error code/trace/identity, emit missing structural gap, preserve original context/trace.
failure_semantics.unexpected_adapter_failure: Return ERROR, empty evidence, UNAVAILABLE coverage, typed missing gap and EVIDENCE_ADAPTER_ERROR; log sanitized code with existing logging. Catch only adapter-stage exceptions.
failure_semantics.error_exposure: Return necessary identifiers and field names only; no raw exception text, secrets, headers, absolute filesystem paths or full source text in error logs.

optional_fields.relevance: Existing finite retrieval score, not confidence; nullable only where source type permits, no invented value.
optional_fields.source_page: Optional PaperBlock cross-check; output SourceLocator.page is checked page_start.
optional_fields.bbox_and_parser_annotations: Remain in unchanged server-owned PaperBlock; not required sidecar output and no new provenance inference.
optional_fields.unknown_source_id: No separate source_id exists in current ContextItem/EvidenceItem/PaperBlock. No synthetic replacement or source-id fallback is allowed.
